claims.quote: Badis kyar is a slender badid from the upper Ayeyarwady River basin in northern Myanmar, recorded near Myitkyina and in the lower Shweli River.
When describing the species in 2002 Kullander and Britz noted that this species had only been recorded from two areas within the upper Ayeyarwady River basin in northern Myanmar.
